title: Saturn is so light for its size that it is less dense than water.

scenes.voice: Fun fact: Saturn is so light for its size that it is less dense than water.
Also, a single pineapple can take around two years to grow.
Also, tiny animals called tardigrades have survived exposure to the vacuum of space.
Also, a day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
